title: AstralPrimitives wire schema
description: Canonical JSON output of to_dict() and model_dump() for the primitives shipped by this AstralPrimitives release. A field whose value is None is omitted entirely, as is an empty css block, so these omittable properties do not accept an explicit top-level null in this schema; nested values permitted by a field's own type, such as values inside unconstrained lists or dicts, may still contain null. attributes is a trusted escape hatch merged last into the top-level object: additional keys are always accepted, but overriding a declared key, including type, may intentionally produce output outside this baseline schema. Custom registered primitives are not part of this versioned baseline.

chart_dataset.description: Serialized shape of the public ChartDataset helper model. No primitive field references it, so this definition documents the helper without constraining any wire field.
